$why: A FRAGMENT prepended to the detective prompt on a retry, 2026-08-16.
A retry that repeats the original instruction gets the original answer. This says what
went wrong — no JSON array came back, probably because a write tool was called — which is
the only new information the second attempt has.
It is a template like any other prompt text. Retry fragments are the easiest thing to
leave embedded, precisely because they are short and feel like plumbing.
body: \n\nRETRY — your previous reply contained NO JSON array (you may have called a write tool). Emit ONLY the JSON array as text in THIS reply now. Do NOT call WriteFile or write to any file.
description: Prepended to the detective prompt when its previous reply contained no JSON array.
